faqs.a: Kling Image 4.0 is Kuaishou’s image-generation and editing model. It creates a single still or an ordered Image Set from a prompt, with optional reference images in Edit.

faqs.q: What output sizes and aspect ratios can I select?
faqs.a: Create offers 2K, 4K and 8K in both modes. Available aspect ratios are Auto, 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3 and 21:9.
Attach one to ten images in Edit and refer to them in the order attached, from @Image1 to @Image10. Tell the model which image defines the product, subject, composition or style.
Choose a count from two to ten to generate an ordered group of related images from one brief. Outline the views or shots in order and check which details carry across the set.

faqs.q: How much does Kling Image 4.0 cost?
faqs.a: Create shows the current amount for your exact settings before confirmation. Choose your resolution and output count to see the quote for the still or full set.

faqs.q: Can I use a Kling Image still as a video starting frame?
faqs.a: Save the still, then select it as the opening image of an image-to-video generation with Kling 4.0. The video has its own settings and quote.

tabs.copy: Use @Image1 for the exact shape and proportions of the flashlight. Use @Image2 only for the cool blue lighting and dark volcanic rock. Place the flashlight on wet basalt with the same button and lens details.

tabs.label: Image Set
tabs.title: Plan three connected frames
tabs.description: Select three outputs in Create before generating.
tabs.copy: Create a three-image story about a photographer crossing a stormy bay. Keep the same red coat, camera and colour palette. Open with a wide shot on the ferry deck. Follow with a medium shot at the rain-covered window. Finish on a close-up of a hand gripping the camera strap.

items.title: A photographer on a ferry in a storm
items.prompt: Cinematic editorial still photograph for a model prompt guide. Landscape 3:2. On a ferry in a storm, a middle-aged East Asian documentary photographer in a red waterproof coat stands at a dark window, seen in slightly imperfect side profile, holding a weathered film camera at chest height. Outside, cold cobalt sea and sea spray, a warm fluorescent ceiling practical gives pale amber rim light to wet fabric. Close medium shot, human and unposed, careful fine texture and layered reflections, no typography, brand or watermark.
